command: pre-registration: S2RG, scene 2 (LIVING_ROOM_SCENE5) on NEW states, layout O: SR 52's ReGuide (rg.py's controller, unchanged) ported to scene 2 (rgp: OWLv2 + depth + calibration poses as SR 63; rgo: simulator poses), against I and SR 63's Hp, on frozen pi0.5 (PRIMARY) and pi0 (docs/SCAFFOLD_RESULTS.md 68)

metrics.deviations_planned: Layout O only.  Client seed 7 and server seed 13 kept from SR 50-67 (state and branch seeds are new).  Hp runs SR 63's client unchanged.  ReGuide's controller class is rg.py's, unchanged; the port changes its entity sets (mugs; plates; no masked class), declares every entity round (no perceived yaw), mines the statistics from the compound's per-mug cycles, uses SR 63's OWLv2 perception with re-detection at hold onsets and Hp's held-mug identity rule, and keeps SR 52's 18 deviations (experiments/prereg/reguide_choices.txt) otherwise.  GR00T not run (NOT TESTABLE on every earlier scene-2 state set).  Depth and camera calibration stay privileged.  Ledger tree dirty (other agents' files).
metrics.information: rgp reads the same inputs as Hp (OWLv2 boxes on the policy's agentview image, the rendered depth and the camera calibration, ProprioHeld) plus ReGuide's demonstration statistics, mined from scene 2's only training demos (the LIBERO-10 compound's raw demos, which Hp's P constants also come from).  rgo reads simulator poses every step (PRIVILEGED).  Neither reads any N1 / N2 demo (none exists) or any lookup of trained pairings beyond the statistics.  The simulator oracle is logged, never fed to rgp.
metrics.labels: NEW states (LIBERO sampler on K1's BDDL, seeds 980000 + k, none equal to an SR 50-67 state), main k = 4-63 (60), branches seed_base 46000000 + 1000 k; layout O; tasks K1, K2, N1, N2; client seed 7, --bind track.  Models: frozen pi0.5 (PRIMARY; pp_serve_purify --model pi05 --mode intact --comp= --seed 13) and frozen pi0 (SECONDARY; serve_guided --mode ours --seed 13, BACKBONE_CONFIG=pi0_libero).  Arms per model: I (s2.py client), Hp (SR 63, s2fix3.py client --arm Hp, unchanged), rgp (SR 52's ReGuide controller, unchanged, ported to scene 2 with SR 63's OWLv2 + depth + calibration poses; s2rg.py client --arm rgp), rgo (the same controller on simulator poses, PRIVILEGED; s2rg.py client --arm rgo).  Success = the BDDL goal.  Matrices [task, state].  Paired bootstrap over states, tasks fixed (s2.boot2_states, B = 2000, numpy default_rng(0); CI = 2.5 / 97.5).  Per model, registered labels for rgp (PRIMARY arm; the same labels reported for rgo as SECONDARY): (V1, SR 62's rule) dN = rgp - I on N1+N2, dK = rgp - I on K1+K2: FIX WORKS iff dN lo > 0 AND dK lo > -.05 (NON-INFERIOR at margin -.05); PARTIAL iff exactly one holds; FAILS iff neither.  (V2) rgp - Hp on N1+N2: RG WINS iff lo > 0; HP WINS iff hi < 0; EQUIVALENT iff the CI lies inside [-.10, +.10]; otherwise NO CLEAR DIFFERENCE; a win label takes precedence.  (V3) BAR: MEETS BAR iff rgp's N1+N2 success >= .50 AND dN lo > 0 (SR 54's FIXED); else BELOW BAR; descriptive beside it: the state-bootstrap CI of rgp's N1+N2 success.  PRIMARY: V1-V3 on pi0.5.  SR 50's floor on every model: TESTABLE iff its I K1+K2 success >= .70 on these states; a NOT TESTABLE model's labels read NOT TESTABLE with the rule's outcome descriptive.  MECHANISM (registered, descriptive): (a) the share of episodes whose FIRST hold-detector onset holds the named mug by the logged simulator rule (an episode with no onset counts as not named), per task, for Hp (identical to I up to the first named hold, by construction), rgp and rgo; on N2 rgp - Hp paired over states, and N2 success given a named / other first hold; (b) the plate each mug ends on (final LIBERO On predicates) per arm and task, and on N1 / N2 the share of episodes in which the named mug ends on the plate the instruction does not name (the F1 place cue: its trained plate); (c) ReGuide's transports per task (approach / carry / release, and why).  SECONDARY: Hp's FIX label per model (SR 63 replication); rgp - Hp on K1+K2 and K2 (GAIN iff lo > 0, COST iff hi < 0, else NO CLEAR DIFFERENCE); rgo - rgp on N1+N2.  Descriptive: rgp perception (registration of the instructed mug and both plates, target plate xy error, side, onset held-mug identity against the simulator rule), episode length and time-outs.  C1: the reference planner (s2.plan_episode via s2cue3.ref_eps, unchanged) on the main states; MET iff its N1-N2 success >= .80.
metrics.port:
what changes against SR 52 / 65's rgp; everything else is rg.py's ReGuide class, imported and unchanged):
  - Entities.  rg.MOVABLE (the referent set of Eq. 3 for objects) = the three mugs; rg.DESTS (destinations) = the two plates (the
    scene's only goal entities: the habitual set of the single training scene, as SR 52 D3); rg.MASKED = () (no masked class here).
    The instructed mug and plate are parsed from the instruction (s2fix4.parse_named, s2fix6.parse_plates; asserted equal to the
    task's object and target).
  - Declared geometry (mode `stats`): the asset meshes of the 3 mugs and 2 plates at rest in a scene-2 env (rg_stats.geom_points).
    Every entity is treated as ROUND (symmetric: world-axis box, posture = the approach axis only), because OWLv2 boxes give no yaw;
    a mug's footprint half-width = its mesh radius (handle included).  rgo uses the same declaration.
  - Statistics (mode `stats`, rg_stats.py's rules and Table 5's quantile levels, unchanged in kind): from scene 2's only
    demonstrations, the LIBERO-10 compound's 50 raw demos (s2_tasks.DUMP: recorded states + actions, replayed, never executed), one
    close-open cycle per mug: the white mug's cycle is a K1 demo (-> plate_1), the yellow-and-white mug's a K2 demo (-> plate_2).  No
    N1 / N2 demo exists.  The approach segment of the second cycle starts after the first cycle's release.  Plate frames and
    release offsets in world axes (round plates).  The red mug inherits the nearest mug's statistics (A.6).
  - rgp perception: SR 63's (s2fix3.Percept: OWLv2 sidecar on the policy's agentview image + rendered depth + camera calibration,
    CAL / PLATE_LOC / SIDE_RULE unchanged), the same privilege as Hp.  Registration once at the first gated step (n = WAIT, as Hp
    and paper C.6): every detected mug, and the plates by SIDE_RULE (left = plate_1, right = plate_2).  If the instructed mug or
    plate is not perceived, ReGuide stays inactive in that episode (the policy acts alone; logged).  Hold events: ProprioHeld (sc_rv
    lex), as rgp.  At each hold onset OWLv2 runs again (Hp's rule): detected mugs update their positions, and the held mug's identity
    is Hp's (the nearest perceived mug within HELD_R of the hand).  ReGuide's interaction state is "the INSTRUCTED mug is held"
    (as rgo's oracle state, which tracks the instructed object only): a hold of another mug is not an attachment.  While attached the
    instructed mug follows the hand rigidly from the onset (rgp's rule); at a release it stays where the hand left it.
  - rgo (PRIVILEGED): simulator body positions of every mug and plate every step; rg.py's oracle interaction rule on the instructed
    mug (rose > 3 cm above rest within 12 cm of the hand; detached when co-motion ends).  A ProprioHeld detector and the simulator's
    held-mug rule are stepped for the LOG only (first-hold identity), never fed.
  - Harness: s2.py's (s2_living suite, --fresh / --branches, s2.Rec2's oracle track), client seed 7, --bind track; ReGuide wraps the
    env and the websocket client exactly as rg.py does (the pending chunk -> predicted endpoint; no query while ReGuide steers; a
    hand-back discards the pending chunk).  Prompt and images are never changed.
metrics.prediction:
S2RG predictions (SR 68), written 2026-11-16 BEFORE any job of this probe (prep, statistics, states, smoke or main), and before
experiments/s2rg.py was finished.  Nothing of this probe has been run.

What is tested.  ReGuide (SR 52's reimplementation, experiments/rg.py's controller class, unchanged) ported to scene 2 (LIBERO-10
LIVING_ROOM_SCENE5): it rebinds the instructed mug (approach transports to the instructed mug's demonstrated pre-contact pose when
the policy's predicted endpoint commits to another mug, or on no progress), and steers the held instructed mug to the instructed
plate (carry transports on a wrong-destination commitment), then hands control back to the frozen policy.  Arms: I, Hp (SR 63,
unchanged), rgp (poses from SR 63's OWLv2 + rendered depth + calibration, the same privilege as Hp; registration at the first gated
step, re-detection at hold onsets, the held mug's identity by Hp's rule), rgo (simulator poses every step, rg.py's oracle hold rule).
Statistics from scene 2's only training demos (the LIBERO-10 compound, one close-open cycle per mug: K1 = white -> left, K2 =
yellow-and-white -> right).  Models: frozen pi0.5 (PRIMARY), pi0 (SECONDARY).  60 new states (seeds 980000 + k), layout O.

What I expect mechanistically, before any run.
- N1 (white -> right): the VLA grasps the right mug (its trained K1 grasp) and heads for the left plate; ReGuide's wrong-destination
  trigger fires and carries it to the right plate, then hands back one step above release height.  The open risk is that pi0.5,
  re-queried above the right plate, carries it back toward the left plate (strong F1 routing in this scene, SR 57-61); the re-arm
  certificate allows a second carry and the dwell rule a scripted release.  I expect N1 near Hp's.
- N2 (yellow-and-white -> left): pi0.5 heads for the white mug first (SR 63-67: 60 of 60 under I / Hp).  ReGuide's wrong-binding
  trigger should fire and move the hand to the yellow-and-white mug's pre-contact pose.  Whether pi0.5 then grasps that mug or goes
  back to the white mug (its trained first step, SR 64 / 67) is the main uncertainty.  If the named mug is held first, the VLA heads
  for the right plate and ReGuide carries it to the still-empty left plate, which should succeed often.  If the white mug is held
  first, ReGuide does not treat it as the instructed object; the VLA places it on the left plate, then takes the named mug, and
  ReGuide carries that onto the occupied left plate, as Hp's P does (success given that ~.25, SR 67).
- K2: the same early wrong-binding trigger fires on K2 (white first is the VLA's trained order), so rgp may disturb K2's trained
  program, as the views did (SR 66).  K1: few triggers.

pi0.5 (60 new states; PRIMARY):
- I: K1 ~.99, K2 ~1.00, N1 0, N2 0.  TESTABLE (95%).
- Hp: N1 ~.50, N2 ~.25, N1+N2 ~.38, K1+K2 ~.99.  Hp FIX WORKS (85%).
- rgp: N1 ~.55, N2 ~.38, N1+N2 ~.46; K1 ~.98, K2 ~.90, K1+K2 ~.94.
- rgo: within +-.08 of rgp on N1+N2 (70%).
- V1 (rgp - I): dN lo > 0 (95%); K1+K2 non-inferiority at -.05 shown 50%.  FIX WORKS 48%, PARTIAL 50%, FAILS 2%.
- V2 (rgp - Hp on N1+N2, ~+.08): RG WINS 30%, NO CLEAR DIFFERENCE 50%, EQUIVALENT (CI inside +-.10) 12%, HP WINS 8%.
- V3 (.50 bar): MEETS BAR 35%, BELOW BAR 65%.  State-bootstrap lower bound of rgp's N1+N2 < .50 (90%).
- Mechanism: N2 first hold is the named mug: Hp 0 (= I up to the first hold, by construction), rgp ~.35 (range .10-.60), rgo ~.40.
  N2 success given a named first hold under rgp ~.70; given a white first hold ~.20.  ReGuide fires an approach transport on >= .80
  of N2 and of K2 episodes, and a carry transport on >= .70 of N1 episodes.  When the named mug is held under rgp on N1 / N2, it
  ends on its trained plate (the plate the instruction does not name) on <= .15 of those episodes (the F1 place cue is overridden),
  against ~.10-.20 under Hp (P also carries it).
- Secondary rgp - Hp on K1+K2: ~-.05, NO CLEAR DIFFERENCE 55%, COST 45%.

pi0 (60 new states; SECONDARY):
- I: K1+K2 ~.82 -> TESTABLE (75%); N 0.
- Hp: N1 ~.45, N2 ~.10, K1+K2 ~.85; Hp FIX WORKS 60%.
- rgp: N1 ~.45, N2 ~.20, N1+N2 ~.33, K1+K2 ~.80.
- V1: FIX WORKS 45%, PARTIAL 50%.  V2: NO CLEAR DIFFERENCE 55%, RG WINS 30%, HP WINS 10%, EQUIVALENT 5%.  V3: BELOW BAR 95%.
- Mechanism: N2 named first hold under rgp ~.25 (SR 65: ReGuide moved pi0's grasp in scene 1).

Perception (pi0.5 rgp): registration of the instructed mug and both plates on >= .97 of episodes; target plate xy median < 1 cm;
onset held-mug identity agreement with the simulator rule >= .95.

C1 (reference planner on the new states): N1 ~.55, N2 ~.98, N1-N2 ~.77 -> C1 MET 45%, UNMET 55%.
